officialTitle: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan in HER2-Mutant Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.blinding: Open-label; response by independent central review
design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 91 patients were enrolled.

clinicalQuestion: What is the efficacy and safety of trastuzumab deruxtecan in previously treated HER2-mutant metastatic NSCLC?

pico.population: Metastatic HER2-mutant NSCLC refractory to standard treatment
pico.outcomes: Primary: ORR by independent central review. Secondary: DoR, PFS, OS, safety

arms.label: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
arms.doseSourceQuote: trastuzumab deruxtecan (6.4 mg per kilogram of body weight) was administered

publications.title: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan in-Mutant Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis (HER2-mutant cohort)

outcomes.sourceQuote: Centrally confirmed objective response occurred in 55% of the patients (95% confidence interval [CI], 44 to 65).
The median duration of response was 9.3 months (95% CI, 5.7 to 14.7).
Median progression-free survival was 8.2 months (95% CI, 6.0 to 11.9), and median overall survival was 17.8 months (95% CI, 13.8 to 22.1).
Median progression-free survival was 8.2 months (95% CI, 6.0 to 11.9), and median overall survival was 17.8 months (95% CI, 13.8 to 22.1).

safety.sourceQuote: grade 3 or higher drug-related adverse events occurred in 46% of patients, the most common event being neutropenia (in 19%).
Adjudicated drug-related interstitial lung disease occurred in 26% of patients and resulted in death in 2 patients.

limitations: High rate of interstitial lung disease at this dose

clinicalImplications.text: Established trastuzumab deruxtecan as an active therapy for previously treated HER2-mutant NSCLC, with ILD as the key toxicity requiring vigilant monitoring.

tumourBoardPearl.text: HER2 mutation, not HER2 overexpression, was the selection biomarker here — and ILD surveillance is mandatory.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 34534430. Dose frequency not printed in abstract.
